//: The single guardrail configuration. Every surface action in discovery and replay passes through PolicyGate.check() against this file.

allowlist.//: Loci are anchored regexes. Anything not matched is refused before the driver is touched — including a navigation the model invents.

risk.//: read/write proceed; irreversible needs an explicit per-invocation confirmation or a human decision obtained through escalation. Blocking it outright would make the system useless for the servicing work it exists to do; letting it through unattended is how you double-post a transaction.

redaction.//: Institution-specific patterns layered on top of the built-in ones (SSN, PAN, email, JWT, credential assignments).
